svg.text: Does epithelial identity alter fibroblast protein output?
NKX2-1 identity and viable source amount must be distinguished
Identity contrast beyond viable epithelial amount • comparable recipient states
Dashed: proposed comparison / readout • icons and counts are qualitative
Broad prediction failed; C3 is not a stable proxy. Extracellular abundance alone is not a secretion rate.
